summary: Re-verified the P0 Rummy 'stuck-spectator / stale-table-resume' fix on RummyTable.jsx. All three guards work: (1) STALE/SPECTATOR — player1 opened lobby with player2's tableId in localStorage; app bailed to the lobby and cleared royal11_casino_table. (2) DEAD-TABLE — with a bogus tableId in localStorage, /state returned 400/404, app bailed to lobby and cleared storage. (3) Leave-table — settings menu opens, rummy-leave button is visible and enabled (disabled: False), clicking it exits to lobby, clears localStorage, and a subsequent full page reload does NOT re-pin the user to the same table. Overlay data-testids (rummy-table, rummy-wordmark, rummy-variant-label, rummy-settings-btn, rummy-coin-balance, rummy-room-code, rummy-settings-menu, rummy-leave) all present. body.rummy-immersive class applied while on the table.

issues: When Quick Play joins a table whose previous round just SETTLED, the Round Result modal renders over the settings gear and can intercept the rummy-settings-btn click (needs to be dismissed via Continue first). Not a regression of this fix, but worth surfacing — consider making the settings gear stay above the summary modal or auto-dismissing summaries older than the current session.

critical_code_review_comments: RummyTable.jsx loadState guard (lines 156-166) correctly checks seats.length>0 && !amSeated before pinning — good.
doLeave (lines 263-267) always calls onLeave() in finally — good defensive UX.
rummy-leave button (line 329) is disabled={busy} only — correct per fix.
CasinoPage.jsx loadState (67-81) also has 400/404 guard clearing localStorage — matches the RummyTable guard for High Card flow.

Minor: casino-game-rummy_points click via Playwright force=True occasionally didn't register when a prior high-card session was active in the same tab; JS-level click always worked. Not a real bug, just a test-selector observation.
seed_data_creation: None; used existing seeded users and existing practice tables.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The stuck-spectator P0 fix (RummyTable.jsx loadState + doLeave) is verified end-to-end via the public URL. If regressing, quickest repro: login as player1, put another player's tableId into localStorage.royal11_casino_table with royal11_casino_game=rummy_points, visit /casino — should bail to lobby with toast 'You're not seated at this table' and clear localStorage. Note that the round-result summary modal can obscure the settings gear right after Quick Play joins a mid-hand table; press Continue first before opening settings.
rca of the issue: Original bug: RummyTable auto-resumed on any stored tableId, even when the user was not among the seats — user was pinned as a spectator with a disabled Leave button. Fix (verified): loadState now bails via onLeave() when seats.length>0 && !amSeated, and also on 400/404; doLeave always calls onLeave() in the finally block; rummy-leave button is disabled only while busy. localStorage keys royal11_casino_table + royal11_casino_game are cleared by CasinoPage's effect when tableId becomes null.
